item.title: Greeley’s home team: How UNC Athletics empowers local youth
item.description: "The more connected any university is to its town, its community, the better it's going to be for everybody," UNC men's basketball coach Steve Smiley said. "We've really put an emphasis in our program to try to grow that connection and connect with the community even more."

item.title: CSU Rams snap losing skid with win over San Jose State
item.description: FORT COLLINS — Colorado State snapped a three-game losing streak with a 65-57 victory over San Jose State on Saturday at Moby Arena. With the win, the Rams improved to 13-10 overall and 4-8 in the Mountain West Conference. They had lost eight of their previous 11 games prior to Saturday’s win over the Spartans. item.title: Asking Eric: 70-year-old fears he is a sugar daddy
item.description: This week, Asking Eric tackles the "sugar daddy" dilemma in a 28-year age gap relationship when an artist partner becomes entitled. Also, he offers a path forward for a woman struggling with a 50-year friendship that has mysteriously withered, possibly due to hidden health issues.

item.title: Your Daily Horoscope for February 8, 2026
